data.exact_reserve_text: As a result of favourable experience during 2014, there has been a release of GBP 4.7m of prior year reserves.
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reported a release of prior year claims reserves of GBP 4.7m in 2014, reflecting favourable claims experience. Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2014 were GBP 25.444m. The release represents approximately an 18.5% reduction of the opening gross claims reserves. No more granular per-line or per-event prior-year reserve movements are disclosed.
raw_causal_phrases: release of GBP 4.7m of prior year reserves

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development amount comes from narrative note stating a "release of GBP 4.7m of prior year reserves"; the note does not explicitly state whether this is gross or net of reinsurance. No movement reconciliation note showing a gross prior-year movement or a claims development triangle was located. No per-line (LOB) breakdown of prior year movements is provided.
